title: Results and errors
summary: An outcome type for operations that are expected to fail. Errors are values with a stable code and a kind, so a failure appears in the signature instead of being discovered at runtime. A result nobody assigned is a failure that already states a reason, so a forgotten assignment cannot pass as a success and propagating one never throws.
useWhen: An operation can fail in a way the caller should handle. Do not write your own Result, Either, Maybe or OperationOutcome type.
